experiment_purpose: 09-18 anchor-dominance hypothesis: shared anchor (2000/class x 10 = 20,000) dwarfs small expert blocks (dos 1,314 rows, ransomware 391-491 rows), possibly giving those experts a WORSE effective class-prior for their own class than global has. Shrink anchor 10x (2000->200) so it stays nonzero for every class (never a purely single-class context, e.g. dos-only) while cutting the anchor:block dominance ratio from ~15:1 to ~1.5:1 for the smallest blocks. expert_select_mode reverted to residual (exp31 default) since the 09-18 confident/random sweep showed selection mode has ~no effect (dos delta -0.524/-0.520/-0.525 across residual/confident/random, essentially identical).
